content: भ्रान्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [भ्रम्-क्त] .²1 Wandered or roamed about. .²2 Turned round, whirled, revolved. .²3 Erred, mistaken, gone astray. .²4 Perplexed, confused. .²5 Moving about, moving to and fro, wheeling. .²6 Whirling or turning round, roaming or wandering about. .{@-तः@} .²1 An elephant in rut. .²2 A kind of thorn-apple. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Roaming, moving about; वरं पर्वतदुर्गेषु भ्रान्तं वनचरैः सह <ls>Bh. 2. 14</ls>. .²2 A mistake, an error. .²3 A particular mode of fighting.
